packs.title: Stockyards, Art and Gardens
packs.promise: Explore Fort Worth’s Western landmarks, museum collections and green spaces.

q.s: Explore food vocabulary without needing to order.
st: Choose two menus visible from permitted public browsing space.
Collect one unfamiliar dish name or ingredient from each.
Write what each menu actually explains and one question left unanswered.

q.s: Make an original response to a form you notice.
st: Choose an artwork in an open gallery and read its credit information.
Select one relationship between shapes rather than the entire composition.
Make a small original drawing that changes that relationship, noting the source artwork.

q.s: Separate what an image shows from what its label explains.
st: Choose a work in an open gallery.
Record one visible detail and one fact supplied by its label, including the credited maker.
Write how the fact changes or sharpens your understanding of the detail.
